validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <state id="p">
    <initial/>
    <state id="c">
      <transition event="go" target="d"/>
    </state>
    <final id="d"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: initial must contain exactly one transition
notes: `<initial>` describes one default entry; its single transition names the default child states
diagnostics.help: add exactly one target-only transition inside `initial`
